general.description: Configure the return rules and maintain the reasons

index.textReasons: A customer picks a reason when opening a return. The reasons are the shop's own data: add, disable or delete them at any time. A reason that is disabled stays on the returns that already picked it.

reason.title: Return reasons
reason.placeholderLabel: e.g. the size does not fit
reason.helpTextPosition: A lower number is listed first.
reason.helpTextActive: A disabled reason can not be picked anymore; the returns that already picked it keep it.
reason.notificationSaveError: The reason could not be saved.

notification.saveError: The return settings could not be saved.
